Name: Stardew Predictor Sync PC
Author: Vmatos98
Description:
[b]Bring your farm's data to the palm of your hand![/b] 📱✨ The [b]Stardew Predictor Sync[/b] is a lightweight companion mod designed to connect your PC gameplay directly to the [b]Stardew Predictor App[/b] (available on the Google Play Store).
Instead of manually checking wikis or keeping track of what you've done, this mod silently reads your progress when your farmer goes to sleep and sends a tiny summary to your phone.
[b]✨ Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Real-Time Tracking:[/b] Open the app on your phone to instantly see your farm's daily predictions and progress.[/*]
[*][b]No Accounts Required:[/b] Uses a simple 6-digit "Sync Code" generated by the mobile app to pair your devices. No emails, no passwords.[/*]
[*][b]Ultra Lightweight & Private:[/b] It does [b]not[/b] upload your actual save file. It only extracts a tiny 2KB data package containing your stats, saving your bandwidth and protecting your privacy.[/*]
[/list][b]📊 What data is synced to your phone?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Info:[/b] Farm name, Farmer name, Current Date, and Year.[/*]
[*][b]Predictions:[/b] Geodes cracked and deepest Mine levels reached.[/*]
[*][b][NEW] Museum Collection:[/b] Tracks exactly which artifacts and minerals you have donated and which ones are missing.[/*]
[*][b][NEW] The Perfection Tracker:[/b] Syncs your Caught Fish, Cooked Recipes, and Shipped Items![/*]
[/list][b]⚙️ How to Install & Use:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.predictor.stard]Download the Stardew Predictor App[/url] on your phone and get your unique [b]Sync Code[/b]. 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.predictor.stardhttps://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.predictor.stardew[/*]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] on your PC.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it into your
[code]StardewValley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, click the ⚙️ (Settings) icon on the title screen to open GMCM, and enter your Sync Code.[/*]
[*]Play the game! Every time your character goes to sleep, the data is automatically updated on your app.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Predictor Sync
Manifest.Description: Sincroniza automaticamente os dados do seu save com o Stardew Predictor via código do aplicativo.
